title: Edge majority is invariant under relabeling
statement: For every natural number $v$, the Boolean property of a graph on $v$ vertices that declares the graph to have edge majority when the total number of possible edges is at most twice the number of present edges is invariant under every permutation of the vertices.
hypotheses_covered: The graph is a Boolean encoding of edges on $v$ vertices
The relabeling is a permutation of the vertices
